description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI in the OrangeHRM project, testing various API endpoints and validation rules related to reporting method configurations within the Pim module.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI endpoints and validation rules.

methods.description: Tests validation rules for fetching a single reporting method.

methods.name: testDelete

methods.name: testUpdate
